info.title: Nabla API
info.description: UEBA multi-agent system — API for the web UI

get.description:
Report first-run state.

Anti-reconnaissance shape: requires_setup_token is ONLY revealed
when zero users exist (the registration form needs it). Once a user
exists, the flag disappears — attackers cannot learn the
registration shape from a configured deployment.

post.description:
Register the first user (becomes admin). Rejected once users exist.

If NABLA_SETUP_TOKEN is configured, the request must carry it.

Log in: verify credentials, set the session cookie.

Generic failure shape by design: the same 401 "Invalid username or
password" whether the user is missing or the password is wrong —
no user enumeration.

get.description: Hydrate auth state from the session cookie.

post.description:
Trigger a pipeline run in the background.

Returns immediately with a run_id. Check status via GET /api/pipeline/status.

get.description: Get current pipeline status — running or idle.

Get pipeline run history with pagination.

Args:
    limit: Max runs to return.
    offset: Number of runs to skip.

Returns:
    Dict with runs list and total count.

Get one run record with full detail (UI-4).

Returns the persisted anomalies, findings summary, supervisor
narrative, and step durations for the run detail view. Supports
partial run_id match (first 8 chars), consistent with incidents.

post.description:
SSE stream for pipeline progress events.

Emits step progress events while a pipeline is running.
If no pipeline is running, emits a single idle event.

get.description:
Get dashboard overview data.

Returns:
    Dict with system phase, health checks, entity counts,
    incident counts, and recent runs/incidents.

List all known entities with summary profiles.

Args:
    type: Filter by entity type — user, host, or ip.
    search: Search entity IDs (case-insensitive substring).
    warm: Filter by warm-up status (true=warm, false=cold).
    limit: Max entities to return.
    offset: Number of entities to skip.

Returns:
    Dict with entities list and total count.

Assemble the 'why this risk score' view for one entity.

Combines: recent anomalies for this entity (from persisted run
records — newest `runs` runs), incidents for this entity, and the
risk-category breakdown from the risk store. One call, one story.

put.description:
Add, update, or remove facts for a single entity's context.

Body: {"facts": ["...", "..."]} — replaces the entity's fact list.
An empty list removes the entity from the context document.

get.description:
Get full entity profile detail.

Args:
    entity_id: Entity identifier (username, hostname, or IP).

Returns:
    Full entity profile with EWMA values, typical behavior,
    and environment context facts.

List incidents with optional filters.

Args:
    status: Filter by status — new, investigating, resolved, false_positive.
    severity: Filter by severity — low, medium, high, critical.
    entity: Filter by entity name (exact match) — supports process-typed
        incident groupings (UI-3).
    run_id: Filter by originating pipeline run (UI-3/UI-4).
    limit: Max incidents to return.
    offset: Number of incidents to skip.

Returns:
    Dict with incidents list and total count.

Get incident counts by status and severity.

Returns:
    Dict with by_status and by_severity counts.

Get a single incident by ID.

Args:
    incident_id: Incident UUID (supports partial match, first 8 chars).

Returns:
    Incident dict with evidence, counterfactuals, and timeline.

put.description:
Update an incident's status and/or append notes.

Args:
    incident_id: Incident UUID.
    request: Update request with optional status and notes.

Returns:
    Updated incident dict.

get.description:
Read current watchlist configuration.

Returns:
    Dict of group_name → entity list.

put.description:
Replace watchlist configuration.

Validates all entity values before saving.

get.description:
Read full environment context.

Returns the three-section structure:
- environment: immutable user-declared facts
- entities: immutable per-entity facts
- network_ranges, new_accounts, service_accounts, admin_accounts,
  benign_patterns: mutable state (auto-detected + user-declared)

put.description:
Update environment context.

Only writes to the file — mutable state (auto-detected ranges,
new accounts with timestamps) is re-derived on the next pipeline run.

get.description:
Get current scheduler configuration and status.

Returns:
    Dict with running status, interval, log types, log count,
    next run time.

put.description:
Update scheduler configuration.

Starts or stops the scheduler and changes parameters.

get.description:
Get connector status — which SIEM connectors are configured.

Returns:
    Dict with splunk and sumologic status.

post.description:
Bootstrap the Nabla agent system.

Creates supervisor agent, shared blocks, and tools.
Idempotent — safe to call if already bootstrapped.

Teardown the Nabla agent system.

Removes all Nabla agents and shared blocks.

get.description:
Check system health — Letta, Ollama, data directory.

Returns:
    Dict with health status for each component.

Get threshold calibration state and detection method effectiveness.

Phase 3: thresholds come from the calibration store (label-driven);
the bandit survives unchanged.

Returns:
    Dict with current thresholds (current/default/pinned/evidence),
    label counts, and bandit effectiveness.

post.description:
Export all Nabla learned state as a JSON download.

Returns:
    JSON file with all state files bundled.

Import Nabla state from a JSON file.

Args:
    file: Uploaded JSON file.
    merge: If true, merge with existing state. If false, overwrite.

Returns:
    Dict with import status.

Upload a log file for ad-hoc analysis.

The file is saved to /data/uploads/ and can be referenced
in a pipeline run with source=file.

Args:
    file: Uploaded log file.
    log_type: Log type hint — auth, network, dns, endpoint.
    format: File format hint — csv, json, jsonl, xml, text.

Returns:
    Dict with file_id and path for pipeline use.

get.description:
Get the chronological event timeline for an entity.

Combines anomalies, incidents, and risk score changes into a single
timeline view, sorted chronologically.
Health check endpoint.

ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest
ChatRequest.description:
Request body for a chat message.

Attributes:
    message: The user's message to the supervisor.
    include_reasoning: Whether to include reasoning in the response.

EntitySummary.title: EntitySummary
EntitySummary.description:
One row of the entities table. is_machine is the SAME predicate
baselining and risk use (F5/N9) — the UI says EXCLUDED instead of
showing machine accounts with no baseline and no explanation.

EnvironmentUpdate.title: EnvironmentUpdate
EnvironmentUpdate.description:
Environment context update.

Attributes:
    environment: List of free-form environment facts.
    entities: Dict of entity_name → list of facts.
    network_ranges: List of CIDR network ranges.
    new_accounts: List of new account names.
    service_accounts: List of service account names.
    admin_accounts: List of admin account names.
    benign_patterns: List of benign pattern descriptions.

IncidentUpdateRequest.title: IncidentUpdateRequest
IncidentUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for updating an incident.

Attributes:
    status: New status — new, investigating, resolved, false_positive.
    notes: Operator notes to append.

PipelineRunRequest.title: PipelineRunRequest
PipelineRunRequest.description:
Request body for triggering a pipeline run.

Attributes:
    source: Ingestion source — auto, synthetic, splunk, sumologic, file.
    log_type: Log type(s) — auth, network, dns, endpoint, or all.
    log_count: Number of log entries per type (synthetic only).
    file: Path to uploaded log file (when source=file).
    format: File format hint — csv, json, jsonl, xml, text.
    map: Column mapping — canonical=raw_col,canonical2=raw_col2.
    watchlist_groups: Watchlist groups to target.
    update_baseline: Whether file-sourced runs should update baselines.
        Defaults to false — file uploads are ad-hoc analysis and shouldn't
        shift the baseline. Set to true for onboarding a new log source.

QuarantineState.title: QuarantineState
QuarantineState.description:
The entity's baseline-hold state (N3/N5) as the UI shows it.
days_left is data-clock days; None when not currently held.

RunAnomalySummary.title: RunAnomalySummary
RunAnomalySummary.description:
The compact anomaly shape persisted in run records (R-4: the API
contract is now declared, generated into frontend types, and drift
becomes a build error).

RunRecordResponse.title: RunRecordResponse
RunRecordResponse.description:
One run record. Every field the record can carry is declared —
response models drop undeclared fields, so this IS the contract.
Old records (persisted before a field existed) validate via the
defaults.

ScheduleUpdate.title: ScheduleUpdate
ScheduleUpdate.description:
Schedule configuration update.

Attributes:
    enabled: Start or stop the scheduler.
    interval: Interval in minutes between pipeline runs.
    log_types: Comma-separated log types.
    log_count: Number of log entries per type.

risk_score.title: Risk Score
risk_score.description: Entity risk score at time of event

TimelineEvent.title: TimelineEvent
TimelineEvent.description: A single event on the timeline.

WatchlistUpdate.title: WatchlistUpdate
WatchlistUpdate.description:
Full watchlist replacement.

Attributes:
    groups: Dict of group_name → entity list.
